verses.text: These are the wise sayings of Solomon. A wise son makes his father glad, but a foolish son brings sorrow to his mother.
Treasure gained by evil does no good, but doing what is right saves people from death.
The LORD does not let good people go hungry, but he refuses to give the wicked what they crave.
Lazy hands make a person poor, but hard-working hands bring wealth.
A son who gathers crops in summer is wise, but a son who sleeps during harvest brings shame.
Blessings crown the heads of good people, but the mouths of the wicked hide violence.
Good people are remembered as a blessing, but the names of the wicked will rot away.
Wise people accept instructions, but a fool who talks too much will fall.
Whoever lives honestly walks safely, but whoever takes crooked paths will be found out.
Whoever winks at evil causes trouble, and a fool who talks too much will fall.
The words of good people are a fountain of life, but the mouths of the wicked hide violence.
Hatred stirs up fights, but love covers over every wrong.
Wisdom is found on the lips of people with understanding, but a rod is for the back of those who have no sense.
Wise people store up knowledge, but the mouths of fools invite ruin.
Rich people's wealth is like a strong city to them, but poverty ruins poor people.
The pay of good people leads to life, but the earnings of the wicked lead to sin.
Whoever accepts correction is on the path to life, but whoever ignores warnings leads others astray.
Whoever hides hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads lies is a fool.
When there are too many words, sin is not far away, but whoever controls their tongue is wise.
The words of good people are like pure silver, but the heart of the wicked is worth little.
The words of good people feed many, but fools die because they have no sense.
The LORD's blessing makes people rich, and he adds no trouble to it.
A fool enjoys doing evil, but a person with understanding enjoys wisdom.
What the wicked fear will happen to them, but good people will get what they want.
When the storm has passed, the wicked are gone, but good people stand firm forever.
A lazy person is to those who send him like vinegar to the teeth or smoke to the eyes.
Respect for the LORD adds years to your life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
Good people can look forward to joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.
The way of the LORD is a safe place for honest people, but it brings ruin to those who do evil.
Good people will never be moved, but the wicked will not stay in the land.
The mouths of good people speak wisdom, but a twisted tongue will be cut off.
Good people know the right thing to say, but the wicked say only twisted things.
